title: Birth of Adolf Hitler
description: Adolf Hitler is born in Braunau am Inn, Austria.

title: Death of Hitler’s Father
description: Hitler’s father dies.

title: Move to Vienna
description: Hitler moves to Vienna and aspires to be an artist; he is rejected by the Academy of Fine Arts.

title: Moves to Germany
description: Hitler moves to Munich, Germany.

title: World War I Service
description: Hitler serves in the German army during World War I, earns medals for bravery, and reaches the rank of corporal.

title: Joins Nazi Party
description: Hitler joins the German Workers’ Party, later renamed the National Socialist German Workers’ Party (Nazi Party).

title: World War I Begins
description: World War I begins.

title: German Defeat
description: Germany surrenders and Kaiser Wilhelm II abdicates.

title: Weimar Republic Proclaimed
description: Proclamation of the Weimar Republic.

title: Treaty of Versailles
description: Treaty of Versailles is signed, imposing harsh terms on Germany.

title: Weimar Constitution
description: Weimar Constitution creates Germany’s first democratic government.

title: Spartacist Uprising
description: Communist revolution attempt is crushed by the Free Corps.

title: Hyperinflation Crisis
description: France occupies the Ruhr; Germany prints money; the mark collapses.

title: Beer Hall Putsch
description: Hitler fails in his coup attempt, is imprisoned, and writes Mein Kampf.

title: Economic Stabilization
description: Dawes Plan leads to temporary economic recovery.

title: Wall Street Crash
description: The Great Depression begins.

title: Economic Crisis
description: Severe unemployment in Germany reaches 6 million.

title: Nazi Party Victory
description: Nazi Party becomes the largest in the Reichstag with 37% of votes.

title: Hitler Becomes Chancellor
description: Hitler becomes Chancellor of Germany.

title: Reichstag Fire Decree
description: Civil rights are suspended.

title: Enabling Act
description: Hitler gains dictatorial powers.

title: Night of the Long Knives
description: Internal purge of Nazi rivals.

title: Hitler Becomes Führer
description: After President Hindenburg dies, Hitler becomes supreme leader.

title: Nuremberg Laws
description: Jews lose citizenship and marriage rights.

title: Rhineland Reoccupation
description: German troops reoccupy the Rhineland.

title: Anschluss
description: Germany annexes Austria.

title: Kristallnacht
description: Jewish shops and synagogues are attacked.

title: Czechoslovakia Occupied
description: Nazi Germany occupies Czechoslovakia.

title: World War II Begins
description: Germany invades Poland.

title: Operation Barbarossa
description: Germany invades the Soviet Union.

title: USA Enters WWII
description: United States enters the war after Pearl Harbor.

title: Auschwitz Liberated
description: Soviet troops liberate Auschwitz.

title: Hitler Dies
description: Hitler commits suicide in his Berlin bunker.

title: Germany Surrenders
description: World War II ends in Europe.

title: Nuremberg Trials
description: Nazi war criminals are tried.

title: Holocaust Memory
description: Memorials, diaries, and archives preserve Holocaust history.

title: Gandhi Appeals for Peace
description: Mahatma Gandhi writes letters to Hitler urging peace and nonviolence.
